in_sanskrit.name: यामनप्प
in_sanskrit.meaning: यामन: यमराज (God of Death) प्प: प्रभाव (Power, influence)
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who has the power and influence of Yama, the God of Death.

in_hindi.name: यामनप्प
in_hindi.meaning: यामन: यमराज (God of Death) प्प: शक्ति (Power)
in_hindi.long_meaning: The one who has the power of Yama, the God of Death.

in_tamil.name: யாமனப்ப
in_tamil.meaning: யாமன: யமர் (God of Death) ப்ப: உதவியம் (Power, strength)
in_tamil.long_meaning: The one who has the power and strength of Yama, the God of Death.

in_telugu.meaning: యామన: యమరాజ (God of Death) ప్ప: శక్తి (Power)
in_telugu.long_meaning: The one who has the power of Yama, the God of Death.

in_marathi.name: Yamanappa
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of Death
